title: Ariane 5 Flight 501 Failure: Report by the Inquiry Board (MIT OCW mirror)
summary: Full-text copy of the Ariane 5 Flight 501 Inquiry Board report hosted by MIT OCW; used for detailed extraction but flagged as a mirror rather than an ESA-hosted official copy.

source_payload.author_or_body: Ariane 501 Inquiry Board, chaired by Prof. J. L. Lions
source_payload.copyability: not embedded in this revision; linked and line-located only
extraction_notes: The report reconstructs the chain from inertial-reference-system exception to diagnostic data interpreted as flight data to nozzle commands and launcher breakup.
The detailed technical account identifies a 64-bit floating-point to 16-bit signed-integer conversion overflow in an unprotected variable related to horizontal velocity.
The report records that Ariane 5's early trajectory produced higher horizontal velocity than Ariane 4 and that tests did not specifically include Ariane 5 trajectory data.

handling_notes: Mirror warning is carried forward to avoid overclaiming permanence.
